author: /root/cad_execution
assessment: Seven bounded CAD contracts adequately exercise the minimal native/GUI/read-only PCB IPC preparation path, independent pad/net/coordinate checks, rule negatives, persisted save/reopen and post-save crash. Source-generation and legacy pcbnew are explicit bounded alternatives, not stable IPC. No production hardware, bottom-side, zones, vias, arbitrary write transaction or unsafe save-crash recovery is admitted. Each later required operation needs its own qualification.
resolved_findings: Corrected official tar URL and recorded archive/extracted image hashes separately.
Use clean Python3.12.15 pinned resolver installation; no inheritance of 3.12.13 runtime evidence.
limits: Specification approval only. Actual commands/semantic outputs and distinct final review required before task acceptance.
